node.statement: Uniform subordination estimate. There are universal C_s,e_s such that, for e<=e_s, every X in A satisfies ||R_a(XR_b)-R_a((Co_P X)R_b)||<=C_s*e||X||. Indeed R_a,R_b lie in S_P, so R_i=Co_P(R_i); replacing each such equality by the registered estimate Co_P(Y)=P(YP)+O(e)||Y||, and replacing Co_P(X) by P(XP)+O(e)||X||, a finite telescoping using the ambient product and associator axioms transforms R_a(XR_b) into R_a((Co_P X)R_b). The factors P,R_a,R_b and Co_P are uniformly bounded: P is nonvanishing because S_P is nonzero, ||R_i||<=1+delta by v, and the compression estimate bounds Co_P. The number of replacements is fixed, so C_s is universal and does not depend on r,a,b.
